GameNative-x64 on the Acer Googlebook

Here is a video of what all I have working on the Acer Googlebook so far with my GameNative-x64 fork.
Changes made for the Googlebook (and others):
- 32bit emulation added for kernels that don't include support
- Linux Session & Apps are also now working
- Rendering artifacts on newer Intel chipsets resolved.
- Sidebar overlay added to Linux App/Session windows (Back or Shift+Esc)
- Per-App scaling support for Linux apps

(For best performance, you will still want to switch to DRI3 presentation in settings)

Updates are released in the GameNative-x64 repo: https://github.com/Bliss-Bass/GameNative-x64
